title: Correct velocity of B
description: Essential: Student must state or calculate v_B = -1.5 m/s (or equivalent magnitude with correct sign/direction).

title: Correct elastic potential energy
description: Essential: Student must state or calculate E_P = 22.5 J.

title: Correct final velocity of C
description: Essential: Student must state or calculate v_C = 0 m/s.

title: Momentum conservation for ejection
description: Important: Student applies momentum conservation to the spring ejection (system A+B+C) to find v_B.

title: Energy conservation for spring
description: Important: Student uses conservation of mechanical energy (elastic PE converts to kinetic energy of A and B) to find E_P.

title: Momentum conservation for collisions
description: Important: Student applies momentum conservation to the final state (A and B stuck to C) to find v_C.

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall: Student makes a sign error in momentum conservation (e.g., treating v_A and v_B as both positive).

title: System isolation error
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly includes the plank's mass in the spring ejection momentum/energy calculations.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Student shows units consistently in calculations or final answers.
